mapper.select: SELECT r.tenant_id,r.rule_version,r.engine_revision,r.expression,r.basis_manifest,r.status,r.content_sha256, v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,r.schema_version,r.schema_manifest_sha256,r.created_by,r.created_at,r.classification, d.content_json,d.base_version,d.base_version_sha256,d.reason,d.authority_grant,d.authority_revision,d.revision FROM rule_version r JOIN rule_definition d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.rule_version=r.rule_version AND d.content_sha256=r.content_sha256 AND d.schema_version=r.schema_version AND d.schema_manifest_sha256=r.schema_manifest_sha256 AND d.created_by=r.created_by AND d.created_at=r.created_at AND d.classification=r.classification JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.version_id=r.rule_version AND v.entity_kind='RULE_VERSION' AND v.owner_project_id IS NULL WHERE r.rule_version=#{ruleId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.rule_version FROM rule_version r LEFT JOIN rule_definition d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.rule_version=r.rule_version WHERE r.rule_version=#{upstreamId} AND r.status='APPROVED' AND (d.rule_version IS NULL OR (d.content_sha256=r.content_sha256 AND d.schema_version=r.schema_version AND d.schema_manifest_sha256=r.schema_manifest_sha256 AND d.created_by=r.created_by AND d.created_at=r.created_at AND d.classification=r.classification AND d.revision > 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rule_approval_decision a JOIN operation_record o ON o.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND o.operation_id=a.operation_id AND o.subject_id=a.created_by AND o.operation_name='TP-04' AND o.target_id=a.rule_version AND o.state='COMPLETED' AND o.http_status=200 AND o.schema_version=a.schema_version AND o.schema_manifest_sha256=a.schema_manifest_sha256 WHERE a.rule_version=r.rule_version AND a.rule_sha256=r.content_sha256 AND a.resulting_revision=d.revision AND a.expected_revision+1=d.revision AND a.decision='APPROVE' AND a.to_status='APPROVED' AND a.from_status IN ('DRAFT','RETURNED') AND a.schema_version='1.0.0' AND a.classification=r.classification AND a.authority_revision > 0 AND a.auth_epoch > 0 AND a.governance_epoch > 0 AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.response_ref,'$.data.decision_id'))=a.decision_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.response_ref,'$.data.operation_id'))=a.operation_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.response_ref,'$.data.rule_version'))=r.rule_version AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.response_ref,'$.data.status'))='APPROVED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.response_ref,'$.data.content_sha256'))=r.content_sha256 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event u WHERE u.subject_id=a.created_by AND u.project_id IS NULL AND u.action='rule.approval_decided' AND u.result='SUCCESS' AND u.schema_manifest_sha256=a.schema_manifest_sha256 AND u.request_id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.response_ref,'$.request_id')) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.resource_ref,'$.decision.decision_id'))=a.decision_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox_event e WHERE e.aggregate_id=r.rule_version AND e.aggregate_revision=d.revision AND e.event_type='rule.approval_decided' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.payload,'$.decision.decision_id'))=a.decision_id))))
SELECT upstream_version_id FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{ruleId} AND relation_kind='RULE_DEFINITION' ORDER BY upstream_version_id
SELECT upstream_version_id FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{ruleId} AND relation_kind='RULE_BASE_VERSION' ORDER BY upstream_version_id

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='TP-03' AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{ruleId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='rule.draft_created'

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{ruleId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='rule.draft_created' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.creation.operation_id'))=#{operationId}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='TP-04' AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE rule_version SET status=#{newStatus} WHERE rule_version=#{ruleId} AND status=#{oldStatus} AND content_sha256=#{hash}
UPDATE rule_definition SET revision=#{resulting} WHERE rule_version=#{ruleId} AND revision=#{expected} AND content_sha256=#{hash}
UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch} AND auth_epoch=#{authEpoch}
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('decision_id',decision_id,'operation_id',operation_id,'rule_version',rule_version, 'rule_sha256',rule_sha256,'decision',decision,'from_status',from_status,'to_status',to_status, 'expected_revision',CAST(expected_revision AS CHAR),'resulting_revision',CAST(resulting_revision AS CHAR),'reason',reason, 'request',request_json,'baseline_manifest',baseline_manifest,'baseline_sha256',baseline_sha256, 'dependency_authorizations',dependency_authorizations,'receipt',receipt_json,'receipt_sha256',receipt_sha256, 'authority_grant',authority_grant,'authority_revision',CAST(authority_revision AS CHAR), 'auth_epoch',CAST(auth_epoch AS CHAR),'governance_epoch',CAST(governance_epoch AS CHAR), 'schema_version',schema_version,'schema_manifest_sha256',schema_manifest_sha256,'created_by',created_by, 'created_at',DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'classification',classification) AS content FROM rule_approval_decision d WHERE decision_id=#{decisionId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND rule_version=#{ruleId} AND created_by=#{userId}
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{ruleId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='rule.approval_decided'

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{ruleId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='rule.approval_decided' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.decision.operation_id'))=#{operationId}
SELECT binding_sha256 FROM simulation_rule_binding WHERE rule_version=#{ruleId}
